subject: general
question: As per information received till November 2020, who is the Chairperson of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Adarsh Kumar Goel**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of November 2020, the **Chairperson of the National Green Tribunal (NGT)** was **Justice Adarsh Kumar Goel**.
 
• Justice Adarsh Kumar Goel, a former judge of the Supreme Court of India, was appointed as the Chairperson of the NGT in **July 2018**.
 
• He Worked toward ensuring a **balance between development and environmental sustainability**.
 
• He Focused on issues like waste management, air and water pollution, deforestation, and industrial compliance with environmental laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NGT was established on 18th October 2010.
 
• NGT is a specialized body set up under the National Green Tribunal Act (2010) for effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to environmental protection and conservation of forests and other natural resources.
 
• The first Chairman of the NGT was Justice Lokeshwar Singh Panta on 18 October 2010.
 
• The Central Government in consultation with CJI is appointed the Chairperson of NGT.
 
• A Selection Committee shall be formed by the central government to appoint the Judicial Members and Expert Members.
